items.name: X26_ammit_roar_a
items.text: one huge menacing roar of a beast that is half lioness half crocodile: raspy, breathy snarl with a throaty rattle, fast attack, pitch falling, close, dry, then silence

items.name: X26_ammit_roar_b
items.text: a big lion roar with a deep crocodile hiss underneath, aggressive and raspy, short and powerful, dry studio recording, no music

items.name: X27_ammit_grunt_a
items.text: a low menacing grunt from a huge crocodile-lion monster: one short throaty huff, close, dry

items.name: X27_ammit_grunt_b
items.text: a deep guttural predator chuff with a low rumble, a warning, single short sound, close, dry

items.name: X28_ammit_growl_a
items.text: a deep guttural growl of a crocodile-lion beast rumbling low and rising in menace, close, dry, no music

items.name: X28_ammit_growl_b
items.text: a low hungry monster growl, wet and throaty, crocodile jaws creaking, slowly building, menacing
